objective.x: To follow the Yamuna through Delhi and work out, standing on the bank, what the city does to the river and what it could do for it. Any reachable water body works — run it on the river, lake, tank or drain nearest you.

description.x: A walk along a river is the shortest way to show students what a city does to its water. Trace the river through the built-up stretch, find the points where the pollution goes in, and look at who lives with the result. Then ask what any of it has to do with the people on the walk.

body.x: A river walk, adjusted to the age of the students and the size of the group.
